[[File:QrrrlToq-TSW4.png|thumb|right|220px|Crown Prince Qrrl Toq of Nazzri read the book stored in the Hall of Edification, which affected his worldview.]]
A thousand-page '''book''' was a compilation of [[Poet/Legends|poems]], journal entries, and [[Historian/Legends|historical]] records focusing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nazzri]]'s last [[Nazzar government|reigning]] [[Emperor-King]], [[Prrit Qabaq]], and the events surrounding the downfall of the planet's [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]]. The tome had survived the purge of all records concerning Qabaq ordered by [[Gender/Legends|his]] daughter [[Ikree]], the first [[Monarch-praefect|queen-praefect]] of the [[Oligarchy|oligarchical]] [[theocracy]] that succeeded Qabaq's government, and came to rest in Nazzri's [[Hall of Edification]].<ref name="TOTJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>

After [[Prince/Legends|Crown Prince]] [[Qrrrl Toq]] of Nazzri read through the volume at least a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] after the establishment of the theocratical government, he decided that instead of attempting to match the achievements of prior monarch-[[praefect]]s, he needed to discover and follow his own way, and subsequently the [[Nazzar/Legends|Nazzar]] prince left Nazzri on a self-imposed [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] known as [[boqeri]].<ref name="TOTJC" />
